reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Prospective monotonic reward-value recording with five probabilities, magnitude blocks and later optional causal perturbation.

checks.reason: No explicit commitment to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated technical protocol for pre-execution settings and transfer is made; local calibration and preregistration alone do not meet M.

Core preparation/recording, delivery magnitude and behavioral acquisition settings lack a complete executable quantitative workflow or concrete calibration-to-setting procedure; listing parameters to freeze later is insufficient.
Timing, delivery, identity and stability checks lack numerical acceptance-to-action thresholds or a concrete derivation of tolerances before the main contrast.
Animal-level pilot variance and meaningful effect planning are present, but no numerical power or confidence-width target is specified for the confirmatory sample.
The hierarchical conceptual model does not specify a likelihood/dispersion decision with diagnostics and a concrete multiplicity procedure across the several primary comparisons.
Repair/redesigned pilot suggestions do not explicitly require a revised frozen procedure and fresh independent confirmatory data after parameter changes.
No complete raw-trial/unit manifest with exact analysis/acquisition versions/settings, calibration records and all technical/biological losses is specified.

checks.quote: a small reward is delivered after the p=0 cue
checks.reason: An unexpected reward after a cue cannot independently manipulate the preceding waiting-period licking/probability relationship; repeated such rewards also change the purported p=0 contingency. The C5 comparison is not the claimed behavior-decorrelation control.

checks.quote: activation at the originally expected time
checks.reason: When a reward is delayed, the packet predicts depression at the missed expected time, with activation when the unexpectedly timed reward arrives. This answer repeatedly reverses the omitted-time sign and uses the wrong response as a mandatory replication gate.

A null linear probability coefficient does not rule out nonlinear uncertainty or heterogeneous delay coding. No meaningful-effect equivalence rule supports the stronger conclusion that information is confined to outcome violations.

explanation_reason: Concrete prospective-value task with held-out-animal analysis, but reverses the omission control and does not test the historical uncertainty direction.
historical_match_reason: The chosen question and primary model concern monotonic prospective value versus event-only signaling, not uncertainty separated from value. No intermediate-peaked uncertainty prediction is tested. Five probabilities and separated epochs alone do not create a direction hit; the reversed expected-time control is an additional critical defect.
